Planning your Starlite Festival 2043 evening in Marbella? Combine a sunset boat charter from Puerto Banús with the headline concert. A Marbella boat rental Starlite Festival 2043 pre-concert cruise lets you watch the sun drop behind La Concha, sip cava on the Mediterranean, and arrive at the Auditorio in relaxed style. This guide covers departure times, boat options, and everything you need to know for a seamless night.

Why a Pre-Concert Cruise Works for Starlite 2043

Starlite Festival concerts typically start at 22:00, with gates opening around 20:00. That leaves a golden window from 18:00 to 20:00 for a sunset cruise. You escape the inland heat, enjoy the cooler sea breeze, and see Marbella’s coastline from the water – from Puerto Banús past the Golden Mile to Cabopino. After the cruise, a 10-minute taxi takes you to the Auditorio. No rush, no stress.

Our Fleet for Starlite Evenings

We offer boats for groups of 5 to 12. All depart from Puerto Banús. Here are the top picks for a pre-concert charter:

  • Astondoa 40 (12.5m, 9 pax) – €749/2h. Perfect for couples or small groups. Flybridge with sunset views.
  • Azimut 39 (12.5m, 11 pax) – €749/2h. Spacious cockpit, great for socialising.
  • Azimut 58 Flybridge (17.6m, 12 pax) – pricing on request. Extra space for larger parties.
  • Mangusta 80 (24m, 12 pax) – €4,719/4h (includes free jet ski). For a premium experience with water toys.

All charters include skipper, fuel, drinks (water, soft drinks, beer, white wine, cava), light snacks, insurance, and IVA. No hidden costs.

Sample Itinerary: Sunset Cruise + Starlite

Here’s a typical timeline for a 2-hour pre-concert charter:

  • 18:00 – Board your boat at Puerto Banús. Meet your skipper, enjoy welcome cava.
  • 18:15 – Depart. Cruise west towards Cala del Faro or east towards Cabopino, depending on wind.
  • 19:00 – Anchor for a swim stop (weather permitting). Snacks and drinks served.
  • 19:45 – Return to Puerto Banús, watching the sunset over the marina.
  • 20:00 – Disembark. Taxi or shuttle to Starlite Auditorio (€15–20, 10 min).
  • 22:00 – Concert begins. You’ve arrived relaxed and ready.

What to Wear and Bring

Evenings in Marbella stay warm (25–30°C in July–August), but the sea breeze can feel cool after sunset. Bring a light jacket or sweater. For the boat: swimwear, sunscreen, sunglasses, and a towel if you plan to swim. For the concert: comfortable shoes (the Auditorio is on a hill), and a small bag (no large backpacks allowed). Leave valuables on the boat – our skipper can secure them.

Booking Tips for Starlite 2043

Starlite Festival is one of Marbella’s biggest events, so boats book up weeks in advance. Reserve your Marbella boat rental at least 2–3 weeks ahead, especially for Tier A boats at €749/2h. For groups of 10+, consider the Mangusta 80 or Azimut 58 – pricing on request via WhatsApp. If you want a later return after the concert, ask about custom charters (e.g., midnight return).

Getting to the Auditorio from Puerto Banús

The Starlite Auditorio is located in the hills above Marbella, about 6 km from Puerto Banús. Taxis are the easiest option – expect €15–20 and a 10–15 minute ride. The port has a taxi rank at the main entrance. Alternatively, check the Starlite website for shuttle services from the port area. If you’re driving, paid parking is available at the Auditorio (book in advance).
